headline: Future Lifestyle Fashions Limited: 38th Committee of Creditors meeting under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
sum: Future Lifestyle Fashions Limited continues its Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process with the 38th meeting of the Committee of Creditors held on 6 July 2026, as intimated to the NSE.
detail: Future Lifestyle Fashions Limited, a fashion and lifestyle retail company, remains under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process. The 38th meeting of the Committee of Creditors was convened on 6 July 2026 and formally intimated to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The frequency and number of CoC meetings typically indicate the complexity of the resolution process, the number of claims under adjudication, and the stage of plan development or negotiation. No public disclosure regarding the outcomes of the 38th meeting (claims admitted/rejected, resolution plan status, timeline extension requests) has been released as of the filing date.

conditions: Committee of Creditors must meet regularly (minimum once every 30 days per IBC Section 22, unless specified otherwise) to review claims, approve resolutions, and decide on plan acceptance
Resolution plan submission and approval require 66% voting majority by value of claims under CIRP
CIRP must be completed within 180 days from the insolvency commencement date, extendable by up to 90 days by CoC majority, or up to 270 days by NCLT approval
approvals: Committee of Creditors approval of any resolution plan (66% threshold)
NCLT approval of the resolution plan if CoC approval is obtained; adjudication of disputed claims by IRP/CoC
Moratorium compliance and creditor claims management under IBC Section 12

triggers.note: CIRP is triggered on admission of the insolvency petition by NCLT; FLFL entered CIRP following creditor default or debtor application
Appointment of an Interim Resolution Professional (IRP) and later Resolution Professional (RP); the RP convenes CoC meetings and manages the CIRP process
